The original proof explicitly gives existence and uniqueness at every layer before row3; common S2 assumptions continue to apply. The last row says in its own explanation that nilpotence of the limit kernel is not necessary, which is correct and consistent with S2/S3. The reviewer accurately verifies the substantive core and offers reasonable editorial rewrites, but turns contextual shorthand and optional extra consequences into an unsubstantiated verdict that a required mathematical goal is incomplete. Treat all those table complaints as one root; do not penalize every suggested editorial rewrite separately.
同一底集上取补是双射：闭集族包含与开集族包含方向相同。原文的两个包含标签并未反向。该错误是可删的局部附加指控，不使正确主审阅成果失效。

The identity drops the constant t-1. In fact G_t(y)-G_t(1)=sum_{k=1}^{t-1}(y^k-1). Already for permitted p=3,N=9,t=2 and y a nontrivial ninth root, its value is y-1, whereas the displayed sum is y. This is a local algebra error; the correct uniform S_k calculation already in the answer repairs the required case without new mathematics.

Two different roots of the same p-power order need not have a quotient of that same order. Take p=3,N=9,x=zeta_9,y=zeta_9^4: both have order 9, while x/y=zeta_9^6 has order 3, so the displayed equality of valuations is false. This assertion is not needed by the subsequent residue calculation, which only uses x,y == 1 mod P.

The central count is certified as complete without a defined cylinder state or an established correspondence between rowmotion and the asserted segment motion. Internal row shifts and the (true) period identity do not imply exactly b visits; this requires the missing boundary-count mechanism. The answer never marks that step as conjectural or incomplete. Finite enumeration by the reviewer confirms the intended count in examples, but cannot be inserted as the candidate general proof.

The answer certifies its concrete near-minimizers have zero trace, all gradients in conv(K union {0}), and vanishing energy. Every matrix in that hull is diagonal. Therefore partial_2 u_1=partial_1 u_2=0; ACL plus the horizontal/vertical zero traces force u_1=u_2=0. Its energy is then dist(0,K)^2=5, contradicting the asserted E->0. The periodic h prescribed with derivative 1/0 and positive average is an additional manifestation of this same missing localized construction, not a separately charged root. A correct localized proof would need a zero-mean oscillatory perturbation and small off-diagonal cutoff errors, which the answer explicitly rules out by its convex-hull claim. This is a false verification of the central requested actual construction, so the task-level RMC cap applies while valid cycle evidence remains positive.

From f(z-g(z)) >= f(z)-||g(z)||^2/2 and f(z-g(z)) >= 0 one cannot conclude f(z)-||g(z)||^2/2 <= 0. Both displayed comparisons are lower bounds on the same quantity. The requested bound ||g(z)||^2>=2f(z) is true, but this is not its proof. The local repair is to use the strong-convexity inequality with w=0 and bound g(z) dot z-||z||^2/2 <=||g(z)||^2/2. This does not impair the independently valid proximal obstruction or create an actual false-prox endorsement.

This is a counterexample to the asserted intermediate containment, not to the task theorem (the homotopy-equivalence hypothesis then fails on components). A component argument repairs it locally; no false core theorem is endorsed.

Take the trivial group and T={a,b}. Then H=Q=h_T and every E over H is already realized with D=E. A nonsurjective B=h_{a}->Q therefore reflects realizability for every E, although S->Q is not surjective. The displayed iff is false as an unqualified characterization of bidirectional testing. The correct local-epimorphism iff for S->Q itself and the actual S6 counterexample are unaffected.

For n=2, diag(-1,1) lies in O_2(Z2) and is I mod2 but has determinant-1; every +/-I times an exponential of a skew matrix has determinant1, contradicting the displayed identity. Moreover exp(2 C) generally does not converge: at n=2^j the valuation of its nonzero nth term is n-v_2(n!)=1, so terms do not tend to0. The same level2 issue affects O_K. Counts and the descent lower-bound proof use this invalid parametrization; the separately high-valuation sharpness witness is valid. The headline target conclusions are true, so this is a material invalid-proof commitment, not evidence of an endorsed false core conclusion warranting a zero cap.

For Q2(i), pi=1+i gives sigma(pi)+pi=2, which is not0 modulo pi^(2M) for M>=2. Also pi^2=2i is not in Q2, so exp(pi^2 A_i) cannot be asserted to lie in O_n(Z2). This is a separate ramified-coefficient error in the proposed base descent construction. Epsilon=2^(M-1)pi is still fixed modulo2^M, and the high-valuation witness remains correct; those independent contributions are preserved. No false optimal-precision theorem itself is established, so no automatic core-zero cap is recommended.

With rho(A)=0 for selected membership, rho(cap) must be ordinary OR and rho(cup) ordinary AND. Even A=X and B=empty contradict both displayed laws using the already stated rho(X)=0,rho(empty)=1. The chosen three-fibre partition also cannot represent arbitrary B: h^{-1}({0,2})=(A cap B) union A^c. The asserted inverse reconstruction is therefore an invalid proof of a true core classification. Material supporting-proof error, not a false core theorem judgment or a separate actual-verification claim; no whole-task core cap.

On a 5-cycle an equivariant color map with c(Tx)=c(x)+1 mod3 would imply c(x)=c(T^5 x)=c(x)+2 mod3. A proper three-coloring exists, but it need not be cyclically permuted by T and is not the claimed construction. The arbitrary-permutation necessity proof is incomplete. Its theorem is true, and there is no separate false endorsement of a supplied wrong core conclusion; ordinary material penalty only.

Every ultrafilter chooses one of the even/odd classes E0,E1. If E_p is in U and E_q in V, the allowed rectangle E_p x E_q has fixed sum parity. Hence one of the alleged plus/minus extensions is impossible. In the FSym counterexample U=V, E_p x E_p lies in the even-sum set, so adding its complement makes the proposed filter improper for every free U. Claims of two constructed witnesses are unsupported/false as constructions, though both broad noninjectivity conclusions are true. The two occurrences are one root. These are invalid proof certificates, not an independently verified supplied core architecture or a false final truth-value verdict; no whole-task cap.

For every nonempty X, R1(X)^G is a singleton, even when X^G is empty. For a finite fixed-point-free action, q_{m,1} (m>=3) has empty source and singleton target. The statement contradicts its earlier correct first-layer count and loses a required boundary case; it is locally repairable.

The unqualified only-if summary is false. q11 and q22 are always identities; on empty X all restrictions are empty bijections; for one-point X every layer is singleton. Section 1.2 gives correct detailed descriptions, so this contradictory final overstatement is a locally removable required-claim error, not an independent supplementary theorem.
